title: Parsnip Potato Cakes

instructions: Place grated parsnips and potatoes in a strainer and press down to remove excess liquid.
In a medium bowl, use your hands to combine vegetables, eggs, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper.
In a large skillet, heat 3 tablespoons oil over medium heat. Use a 1/2-cup measuring cup to form small vegetable cakes. Drop the mixture into oil and flatten with a spatula.
Cook cakes until browned, about 8-12 minutes, flipping once half way through. Once done, place on a baking sheet in the oven to keep warm.
Repeat process until potato-parsnip mixture is used up, adding more oil as needed.
Set cakes on paper towels to soak up any excess oil and serve warm.
